en: A colorized, early 20th‑century bird's‑eye view over a town nestled between green hills. The town has a prominent red church with a tall spire, dense blocks of stone buildings, rail lines or roads, and open green fields in the foreground. Trees frame the lower right corner. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the view, as well as a publisher credit. Across the bottom, there is cursive handwritten correspondence in ink.
